Discovery Events

Type: object

Discovery result with implicit discovery

 No Additional Properties

root timestamp
Type: stringFormat: date-time

RFC 3339 UTC timestamp the discover telemetry event was generated
Example:

"2019-01-17T14:02:29.364Z"

root version
Type: string

Version of the UDMI schema

root generation
Type: stringFormat: date-time

The event's discovery scan trigger's generation timestamp
Example:

"2019-01-17T14:02:29.364Z"

root status

Entry

Type: object
No Additional Properties

root status message
Type: string

A human-readable one-line description of the entry
Example:

"Point is not writable"

root status detail
Type: string

An optional extensive entry which can include more detail, e.g. a complete program stack-trace

root status timestamp
Type: stringFormat: date-time

FC 3339 UTC timestamp the condition was triggered, or most recently updated
Example:

"2018-08-26T21:39:28.364Z"

root status level
Type: integer

The status level should conform to the numerical Stackdriver LogEntry levels. The DEFAULT value of 0 is not allowed (lowest value is 100, maximum 800).

Value must be greater or equal to 100 and lesser or equal to 800 and a multiple of 1


Example:

600

root family
Type: object

root source
Type: string

Optional source qualifier for the discovery scan (e.g., 'model')

root addr
Type: string

The primary address of the device (for indicated family)

root network
Type: string

The family network designator of the discovered device

root event_no
Type: integer

The active or passive series number of this result (matches reported state values)

root active_count
Type: integer

Total number of records expected for this active scan generation (only populated on the event_no=0 start marker event)

Value must be greater or equal to 0

root addrs
Type: array of string

List of target addresses for a partial discovery scan shard (only populated on the event_no=0 start marker event)

 No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root addrs addrs items
Type: string

root families
Type: object

Links to other address families (family and id)

 No Additional Properties

All properties whose name matches the following regular expression must respect the following conditions

Property name regular expression: ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(_[a-z0-9]+)*$
root families Family Discovery

Family Discovery

Type: object

Discovery information for a protocol family.

 No Additional Properties

root families Family Discovery addr
Type: string

Device addr in the namespace of the given family

Must match regular expression: ^[-_.:0-9A-Za-z]+$

root families Family Discovery port
Type: integer

Port number for the family connection (e.g. UDP port for BACnet/IP)

root families Family Discovery ref
Type: string

Point reference in the namespace of the given family

Must match regular expression: ^[-_.:/#0-9A-Za-z]+$

root registries
Type: object

Registry iot cloud models

 No Additional Properties

All properties whose name matches the following regular expression must respect the following conditions

Property name regular expression: ^[A-Z]{2,6}-[1-9][0-9]*$
root registries Cloud Model

Cloud Model

Type: object

Information specific to how the device communicates with the cloud.

 No Additional Properties

root registries Cloud Model functions_ver
Type: integer

Function version of this request

root registries Cloud Model auth_type
Type: enum (of string)

The key type used for cloud communication.

Must be one of:

  • "ES256"
  • "ES256_X509"
  • "RS256"
  • "RS256_X509"

root registries Cloud Model device_key
Type: boolean

Indicates if the device private key is provided in the site model.

root registries Cloud Model resource_type
Type: enum (of string)

The cloud resource type

Must be one of:

  • "DIRECT"
  • "GATEWAY"
  • "FUNNEL"
  • "PROXIED"
  • "REGISTRY"

root registries Cloud Model gateway

Gateway Model

Type: object

Gateway Documentation

 No Additional Properties

root registries Cloud Model gateway gateway_id
Type: string

The device ID of the gateway the device is bound to

Must match regular expression: ^[A-Z]{2,6}-[1-9][0-9]*$
Example:

"GAT-100"

root registries Cloud Model gateway target

Family Localnet Model

Type: object

The type of network

 No Additional Properties

root registries Cloud Model gateway target addr
Type: string

The address of a device on the fieldbus/local network
Examples:

"192.168.1.3"

"41489"

root registries Cloud Model gateway target unitid
Type: string

The slave unit ID of the device for protocol families like modbus
Examples:

"1"

"255"

root registries Cloud Model gateway target network
Type: string

The network designator for this device in the family-defined format
Examples:

"192.168.1.0/24"

"12732"

root registries Cloud Model gateway target adjunct
Type: object
No Additional Properties

All properties whose name matches the following regular expression must respect the following conditions

Property name regular expression: ^[a-z_]+$
root registries Cloud Model gateway target adjunct ^[a-z_]+$
Type: string

root registries Cloud Model gateway target shadow_id
Type: string

Specifies that this is a shadow of the indicated device

root registries Cloud Model gateway target parent_id
Type: string

The device id of the node's parent

root registries Cloud Model gateway target vendor_ref
Type: boolean

If true, then the system should not try to validate the refs

root registries Cloud Model gateway target family
Type: string

The family designator, used only when the entry is not keyed in a family map
Examples:

"ipv4"

"bacnet"

root registries Cloud Model gateway proxy_ids
Type: array of string

An array of all the device IDs which are bound to the device

 No Additional Items

Each item of this array must be:

root registries Cloud Model gateway proxy_ids proxy_ids items
Type: string
Must match regular expression: ^[A-Z]{2,6}-[1-9][0-9]*$

Example:

[
    "AHU-22"
]

root points
Type: object

Information about a specific point name of the device.

 No Additional Properties

All properties whose name matches the following regular expression must respect the following conditions

Property name regular expression: ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(_[a-z0-9]+)*$
root points Point Pointset Model

Point Pointset Model

Type: object

Information about a specific point name of the device.

 No Additional Properties

root points Point Pointset Model units
Type: string

Expected unit configuration for the point

root points Point Pointset Model units_reported
Type: string

Actual input unit that is sent from the device

root points Point Pointset Model type
Type: enum (of string)

Expected data type for the point

Must be one of:

  • "string"
  • "boolean"
  • "number"

root points Point Pointset Model description
Type: string

Detailed description of this point

root points Point Pointset Model writable
Type: boolean

Indicates if this point is writable (else read-only)

root points Point Pointset Model baseline_value
Type: object

Represents the expected baseline value of the point
Example:

22

root points Point Pointset Model baseline_tolerance
Type: number

Maximum deviation from baseline_value
Example:

2

root points Point Pointset Model baseline_state
Type: enum (of string)

Expected state when baseline_value is set as the set_value for this point the config message

Must be one of:

  • "applied"
  • "updating"
  • "overridden"
  • "invalid"
  • "failure"

root points Point Pointset Model range_min
Type: number

Represents the lower bound of the error threshold for a point
Example:

0

root points Point Pointset Model range_max
Type: number

Represents the upper bound of the error threshold for a point
Example:

100

root points Point Pointset Model unchanged_limit_sec
Type: integer

Represents the limit in seconds that a point can be unchanged for
Example:

3600

root points Point Pointset Model cov_increment
Type: number

Triggering threshold for partial cov update publishing
Example:

1

root points Point Pointset Model ref
Type: string

Mapping for the point to an internal resource (e.g. BACnet object reference)
Examples:

"AI3"

"400070"

root points Point Pointset Model url
Type: string

Complete resolved URL of this point as determined by the gateway and ref blocks
Example:

"bacnet://1234/AV/1"

root model structure Discovery Events points Point Pointset Model structure Ref Discovery status level
Type: integer

The status level should conform to the numerical Stackdriver LogEntry levels. The DEFAULT value of 0 is not allowed (lowest value is 100, maximum 800).

Value must be greater or equal to 100 and lesser or equal to 800 and a multiple of 1


Example:

600

root model structure Discovery Events refs Ref Discovery status level
Type: integer

600
